title: Pre-flight: a run log, each run with its report; the page opens fresh
why: Jason, 2026-11-17: "i would like the preflight to log its runs and have the report downloadable from that log line. That way when the page refreshes it always starts fresh and i can go back to the previous report from the log itself." 1. The page opens fresh: every line not run yet, the counts at 0 with how many to test; Run all fills it in as before. 2. A Run log at the foot of the page, under the checklist (Jason: "put log at bottom of page"), newest first: each full run (Run all, the nightly run, a .env change) with when it ended, how long it took, who or what ran it, its ✓ ✗ — counts, how many needed for launch and slow, and Report, which downloads that run's report as it stood when the run ended. The last 50 are kept, in a table of their own (preflight_runs, made on first use, staging's own). 3. A single line's Test updates that line only. Start the system and Pulse still read the latest results.
